title: Origins of Solar Systems Conference
level: Researchers (as stated on the conference page)
about: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference "Origins of Solar Systems" takes place from 13 to 18 June 2027 at Mount Holyoke College, South Hadley, Massachusetts. Applications are submitted through the conference page on grc.org.
